I rewrote this directly, since a release note with all its facts present doesn't need an interview. I dropped "so your transactions show up sooner" and "instead of editing them one by one" because the reader can infer both. I also made the fix line say what now works.

<final>
**Ledgerly 4.2 Release Notes**
Releasing October 14

**What's new**

- Bank feeds: now sync every 15 minutes instead of hourly.
- Bulk invoice editing: edit multiple invoices at once.

**Fixes**

- PDF export: currency symbols now display correctly in exported PDFs.
